study_note: Auxiliary return critic with shared representation gradients. One of three paired-seed exploratory Humanoid Walk state backbones (seed 55, one million agent decisions). Persistent XQC policy collection follows the unchanged random warmup; no inner adaptation or online evaluation runs during training. Full architecture, eager TOLD/XQC training, and all main policy routes are shared. Retain all 40 portable checkpoint/metadata pairs every 25,000 decisions and archive completed raw replay experience once with checkpoint-matched manifests. Auxiliary critics, when enabled, use coefficient 0.1 and differ only in representation detachment. This is not confirmatory evidence or exact trainer resume.
